units.source_text: ——匪徒侮辱了我的妻子之后，就在她身侧坐着哄骗她。

en.t: After the bandit had violated my wife, he sat beside her and tried to coax her with lies.

units.source_text: 我自然无法出声，身体被捆绑在杉树脚下，

en.t: Naturally I could not make a sound, and my body was tied at the foot of a cedar tree,

units.source_text: 但是我多次用眼神暗示妻子，不要被他哄骗。

en.t: but again and again I signaled to my wife with my eyes not to be deceived by him.

units.source_text: 要知道，不管他说什么话，都是扯淡的鬼话。

en.t: You must understand that whatever he said was nothing but absurd nonsense.

units.source_text: 可是我妻子失魂落魄的呆坐在竹叶上，

en.t: But my wife sat blankly on the bamboo leaves as though her soul had left her,

units.source_text: 傻傻的望着自己的膝头。

en.t: staring vacantly at her own knees.

units.source_text: 无论怎么看都像是认真听匪徒的谎言。

en.t: No matter how I looked at her, she seemed to be listening seriously to the bandit's lies.

units.source_text: 我嫉妒愤恨的全身发抖，

en.t: My whole body trembled with jealousy and rage,

units.source_text: 然而匪徒伪善的谎言还在往下说，

en.t: yet the bandit's hypocritical lies kept going on,

units.source_text: 到最后竟然说出了这种鬼话：

en.t: until at last he even said this monstrous nonsense:

units.source_text: “你已经被我侮辱了，很难跟你的丈夫相处下去了。

en.t: "You have already been violated by me, so it will be hard for you to go on living with your husband.

units.source_text: 既然跟他无法过下去了，

en.t: Since you can no longer live with him,
you may as well marry me,

units.source_text: 我正是因为对你痴迷，才会做出这么一件冲动的事情来。”

en.t: I did such a rash thing only because I was obsessed with you."
